rules.labelled: every duct, pipe and cable carrier segment on Level 02 (tag and size), air terminals (size only: their model tags are not unique), distribution boards (tag); fittings and accessories are drawn untagged
rules.shared_labels: short pieces of one run (same tag stem, family and size, each at most 2.0 m in plan, at most 0.45 m apart) share one label, one tag per line
rules.sizes: rectangular W x D in mm as the model's Size; model DN<n> (pipe) and D<n> (round duct) drawn Ø<n>
rules.boxes: page pixels at dpi, origin top left: box = the item's drawn outline with its tag and size text
